_caveat: FA DP-PORT FIXTURE — validates torchaudio.functional.forced_align / merge_tokens only (the Viterbi DP), NOT text normalization or vocab coverage.

Captured from torchaudio's MMS_FA bundle (Meta's multilingual forced-alignment model, CC-BY-NC-4.0), the same model already used for the phase4-fa-tokens-*.json port-fidelity reference — MMS_FA is barred from shipping in this project by Decision 3 (non-commercial licence); this fixture is a DP-correctness reference only, not a claim about the shipping jonatasgrosman models' output.

Emission matrix, target ids, and blank id are real model output on a real short audio window — not synthetic — so the DP is exercised on genuine floating-point log-probabilities, not hand-picked numbers.

_provenance.note: non-ASCII vocab case: 'inútiles' contains accented u, exercises uroman romanization
